entries.statement: GetPropertyInfo tries GetProperty(name, Public|Instance|DeclaredOnly) and, on null, falls back to GetProperty(name, Public|Instance|FlattenHierarchy). This does not fix AmbiguousMatchException: when a derived type hides a base property with `new`, DeclaredOnly succeeds and silently selects the derived member, dropping validation attributes declared on the base; and when the property exists only on a base type, DeclaredOnly returns null and the FlattenHierarchy fallback can itself throw AmbiguousMatchException — the exception the change was written to eliminate.
